pairing_note: The counted statement is the author's Proposition environment at source lines 1239-1244 (label L27), asserting that a Lie superalgebra with trivial centre has an enveloping algebra U(a[u]) with trivial centre; the proof environment at source lines 1246-1344 immediately follows it and is its own proof. The proof reduces to invariants of the adjoint action by the Poincare-Birkhoff-Witt theorem, expands an invariant in the top degree d, extracts the top component of the invariance equation as a linear system, and compares that system with the one expressing triviality of the centre of a to kill every top-degree coefficient; all of it is inside the counted span. The only references inside the span point at the equations labelled A, hq and ad, whose labels lie inside the counted proof, so no navigation stub is needed.
